text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Thursday, Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- According to the paper's opinion pool of 2,800 citizens, 50.57 percent polled consider Macedonia still to be safe place for living; 34.43 percent have negative opinion and 15 percent polled have no opinion at all.
- Macedonian foreign minister Ljubomir Frckovski visiting France emphasized the republic's interest to enter the Union of francopfone countries.
- Macedonian Prime minister Branko Crvenkovski visiting Berlin to attract German businessmen to invest in republic. Macedonia seeks German support for its admittance in the European Union.

- The Macedonian Supreme Court said on Wednesday judges must resist to all outside influences in the processes. It said the quality of civil court trials was low as 61 percent of the rulings are altered.
